card.name: Partway through split-up words
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle or at the start of a word that has been split up, often after a capital letter or 'cl'. Seen in drug names like clindamycin, clomiphene and diclofenac, in 'clots', and in names like Ann Cleeves.

modes.label: Drug names starting cl-
modes.description: The piece after 'cl' inside drug names or clot-related words.

modes.label: Capitalised name starts
modes.description: A piece inside an all-caps drug name or a proper name.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS C<<LOT>>IC is contraindicated in patients

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: A piece partway through an ordinary English word in general web text.
modes.example: b<<oding>> ill; sullen or hostile; threatening

card.plain: It fires inside long or unusual words that get broken into pieces, especially drug names starting with cl-.
